I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/linguistic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - essentially a jailbreak technique dressed up in Hebrew and Arabic characters. The structure suggests I should adopt an alternate identity ("שָׁרְט") that operates under different rules than Claude.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes, alternate identities, or conditional activation based on parsing specific symbols. I'm happy to have a genuine conversation with you about linguistics, Hebrew/Arabic scripts, creative writing, or many other topics.

Is there something I can actually help you with today?
